-- C19.3 ownership only: no enqueue, corpus selection or processing campaign.
CREATE TABLE document_extraction_claims (
    resource_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    owner TEXT NOT NULL,
    claim_token TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','RELEASED')),
    lease_expires_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- C20.1 additive durable contract only; executors are not connected yet.
-- No updates to existing queues, attempts, publisher policy, bytes or history.
CREATE TABLE acquisition_host_state (
    publisher_group TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    next_request_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    blocked_until REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    circuit_until REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    observed_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    consecutive_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(consecutive_failures >= 0),
    retry_after_raw TEXT,
    last_outcome TEXT,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE acquisition_host_permits (
    permit_token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    publisher_group TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES acquisition_host_state(publisher_group),
    host TEXT NOT NULL,
    acquisition_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(acquisition_mode IN ('generic','rating','browser','screener')),
    owner TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','RELEASED')),
    acquired_at REAL NOT NULL,
    lease_expires_at REAL NOT NULL,
    released_at REAL,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    authorization_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    CHECK(lease_expires_at > acquired_at)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_acquisition_host_active
ON acquisition_host_permits(publisher_group,status,lease_expires_at);

-- Durable handoff only. No historic corpus scan or automatic processing.
CREATE TABLE document_processing_inbox (
    content_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES artifact_contents(content_id),
    saved_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE document_processing_work (
    work_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    content_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES artifact_contents(content_id),
    parser_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    parser_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    ocr_engine TEXT NOT NULL,
    ocr_engine_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    options_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    extraction_id INTEGER REFERENCES document_extractions(extraction_id),
    UNIQUE(content_id, parser_name, parser_version, ocr_engine, ocr_engine_version, options_json)
);
CREATE TRIGGER document_processing_saved AFTER INSERT ON artifact_contents
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO document_processing_inbox VALUES (NEW.content_id, NEW.created_at_utc);
END;

-- Additive dispatch inbox. Existing exchange schedule/snapshot/queue history stays intact.
CREATE TABLE exchange_coordinator_tasks (
    task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('attempt', 'weekly_report')),
    scheduled_for TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt >= 0),
    priority INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (priority IN (0, 10, 20)),
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'FAILED')),
    created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner TEXT,
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    lease_until_utc TEXT,
    finished_at_utc TEXT,
    result_json TEXT,
    error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE(kind, scheduled_for, attempt),
    CHECK ((kind = 'attempt' AND attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 3) OR
           (kind = 'weekly_report' AND attempt = 0)),
    CHECK ((state = 'RUNNING' AND owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until_utc IS NOT NULL) OR
           (state != 'RUNNING' AND owner IS NULL AND lease_until_utc IS NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX exchange_coordinator_ready ON exchange_coordinator_tasks(state, priority, scheduled_for, attempt);

-- Bounded admission batches; existing eligibility and claim history remains authoritative.
CREATE TABLE collection_scope_tasks (
 task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
 budget INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (budget BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
 admitted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (admitted >= 0 AND admitted <= budget),
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (state IN ('PENDING','DONE','FAILED')),
 finished_at_utc TEXT,
 result_json TEXT,
 error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX collection_scope_single_pending ON collection_scope_tasks(state) WHERE state='PENDING';

-- Durable bounded admission, independent underlying work claims remain authoritative.
CREATE TABLE periodic_dispatch_tasks (
 task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('delayed','recovery','housekeeping')),
 created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
 budget INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(budget BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
 admitted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(admitted BETWEEN 0 AND budget),
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','DONE','FAILED')),
 result_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 artifact_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 finished_at_utc TEXT,
 next_due_at_utc TEXT,
 result_json TEXT,
 error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX periodic_single_pending ON periodic_dispatch_tasks(kind) WHERE state='PENDING';
